chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Aamir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Abu Maryam, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the sermon of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), was it before the prayer or after it? So he said: Before the prayer. He delivers the sermon, then he prays.
ai.seo_question: When is the Imam's sermon delivered in relation to the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through a chain of prominent Kufan scholars in *Al-Kafi*, confirms the Sunnah of delivering the khutbah prior to the two-rak'ah prayer, a structural norm for both Friday and Eid congregations. It underscores the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) role as the primary legislator of ritual order, establishing the sermon as a prerequisite that precedes the physical act of worship rather than following it.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Aamir, from Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Usman Bin Isa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Maryam, from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I asked himasws about the sermon of Rasool-Allahsaww, was it before the Salāt or after it?’ So heasws said: ‘Before the Salāt’. Hesaww addressed, then he prayed Salāt’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Amir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from abu Maryam who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about the sermon of the Messenger of Allah if it was before or after Salah (prayer). He (the Imam) said, ‘The Messenger of Allah would first deliver sermons, then perform Salah (prayer).”’
